name: Stiiizy | 40's Blunt | Sour Diesel
description:
STIIIZY 40's blunts are rolled with 100% tobacco free, kief dusted wraps. We’ve packed each infused blunt with premium, high quality flower. STIIIZY 40's Blunts are reinventing the experience by introducing unique profiles & unmatched strains with live resin infusion.

Sour Diesel is a sativa with pungent diesel and earthy elements.
